questions.q: Why does a multirotor need a compass for POSHOLD?
options: For altitude and to show the heading in the OSD
To turn the position error into a tilt
questions.explain: Without a heading the controller cannot turn the position error into a tilt.

options: Climb to no lower than nav_rth_altitude
Return at the current altitude without climbing
questions.explain: The return is never below the set altitude.

questions.q: What does INAV do when GPS is lost during RTH?
options: An emergency landing after the timeout
Keeps returning on the remembered heading
The safehome for missions and manual RTH
questions.explain: On a manual RTH home is used.

options: The stick sets the tilt, GPS holds the position
questions.explain: In CRUISE the stick sets the speed; in ATTI — the tilt.
Climb to the RTH altitude first, then turn for home — mandatory in a forest; ON_FW_SPIRAL is a spiral climb for a fixed wing.

options: The distance to home is increasing
The battery is low and the altitude is small
questions.explain: The distance to home increasing during RTH is a sign of a wrong home or compass; RTH aborts into an emergency landing.
